svg.desc: Scatter of kinetic counterspace tests: year on the x axis, altitude on a log scale on the y axis, with LEO, MEO and GEO bands. Destructive tests have debris bubbles sized by cataloged fragments. A table view follows the chart.

g.text: Last destructive DA-ASAT test (as of SWF 9th ed., Apr. 2026)

g.aria-label: Oct 13, 1959. United States, Bold Orion against Explorer 6. Flyby (no intercept). Altitude 200 km.
Jul 9, 1962. United States, Thor / W49 (Operation Fishbowl) against None (high-altitude nuclear test). Nuclear detonation. Altitude 400 km. Opens 3D scene.
Dec 17, 1962. United States, Program 505 (Nike Zeus) against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude 160 km.
Feb 15, 1963. United States, Program 505 (Nike Zeus) against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude 241 km.
Jan 4, 1964. United States, Program 505 (Nike Zeus) against None (simulated target). Non-destructive test. Altitude 146 km.
Feb 14, 1964. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Transit 2A rocket body. Non-destructive test. Altitude 1000 km.
Mar 1, 1964. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown. Non-destructive test. Altitude 674 km.
Apr 21, 1964. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown. Non-destructive test. Altitude 778 km.
May 28, 1964. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown. Non-destructive test. Altitude 932 km.
Nov 16, 1964. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown. Non-destructive test. Altitude 1148 km.
Apr 5, 1965. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Transit 2A rocket body. Non-destructive test. Altitude 826 km.
Mar 30, 1967. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown debris object. Non-destructive test. Altitude 484 km.
May 15, 1968. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown. Non-destructive test. Altitude 823 km.
Nov 21, 1968. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown. Non-destructive test. Altitude 1158 km.
Mar 28, 1970. United States, Program 437 (Thor) against Unknown satellite. Non-destructive test. Altitude 1074 km.
Jan 21, 1984. United States, ASM-135 (F-15) against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude 1000 km.
Sep 13, 1985. United States, ASM-135 (F-15) against Solwind P78-1. Destructive intercept. Altitude 530 km. 285 fragments cataloged. Opens 3D scene.
Jul 5, 2005. China, SC-19 against None known. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Feb 6, 2006. China, SC-19 against None known. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Jan 11, 2007. China, SC-19 against Fengyun-1C. Destructive intercept. Altitude 880 km. 3532 fragments cataloged. Opens 3D scene.
Feb 20, 2008. United States, SM-3 (USS Lake Erie) against USA-193. Destructive intercept. Altitude 220 km. 175 fragments cataloged. Opens 3D scene.
Jan 11, 2010. China, SC-19 against CSS-X-11 ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude 250 km.
Jan 27, 2013. China, Possible SC-19 against Unknown ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude not reported.
May 13, 2013. China, Possible DN-2 against None known. Apogee only (no target). Altitude 30000 km. Opens 3D scene.
Jul 23, 2014. China, Possible DN-2 against Likely ballistic missile. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Oct 30, 2015. China, Possible DN-3 against None known. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Nov 18, 2015. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude 200 km.
May 25, 2016. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude 100 km.
Dec 16, 2016. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude 100 km.
Jul 23, 2017. China, Possible DN-3 against Likely ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude not reported.
Feb 5, 2018. China, Possible DN-3 against CSS-5 ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude not reported.
Mar 26, 2018. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Dec 23, 2018. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Mar 27, 2019. India, PDV Mk-II (Mission Shakti) against Microsat-R. Destructive intercept. Altitude 300 km. 130 fragments cataloged. Opens 3D scene.
Apr 15, 2020. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Dec 16, 2020. Russia, Nudol against None. Non-destructive test. Altitude not reported.
Feb 4, 2021. China, Possible DN-3 against Likely ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude not reported.
Nov 15, 2021. Russia, Nudol (PL-19) against Cosmos 1408. Destructive intercept. Altitude 470 km. 1807 fragments cataloged. Opens 3D scene.
Jun 19, 2022. China, Possible DN-3 against Likely ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude not reported.
Apr 14, 2023. China, Possible DN-3 against Likely ballistic missile. Intercept of suborbital (missile) target. Altitude not reported.

text.tspan: ~30,000 km apogee. Not an intercept (hollow mark).
Peak intercept is still Fengyun-1C (2007): 880 km
Intercept altitudes have not climbed since.

svg.text: Chart A · Kinetic tests: altitude over time. Data: ledger built from SWF Global Counterspace Capabilities (9th ed., Apr. 2026) and cited sources. Companion to Space Security Law.
